dataPrivacy.title: Data Privacy and Protection Policy
dataPrivacy.introductionDetails: At Ramp IT Up, we place the highest importance on your privacy and the security of your personal data. This Data Privacy and Protection Policy outlines how we collect, store, process, and protect your personal information. We are committed to ensuring that all the data you provide us with is handled responsibly and in compliance with privacy laws, including the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173).
dataPrivacy.dataCollectionDetails: We collect various types of personal data such as your name, email, location, and any optional details you share. Data collection occurs during registration, platform interaction, or while using personalized services such as wheelchair-accessibility recommendations.
dataPrivacy.dataUsageDetails: Your data helps us enhance user experience, personalize recommendations for wheelchair-friendly establishments, and optimize search results. Data may also be used for insights or community engagement but is never sold to third parties.
dataPrivacy.dataProtectionDetails: We use encryption technology and secure servers to protect your data. Regular audits ensure your information remains secure. In the event of a breach, users are promptly notified, and mitigation measures are implemented immediately.
dataPrivacy.pwdInclusionDetails: Ramp IT Up promotes inclusivity by ensuring that persons with disabilities (PWDs) have equal access to services and features. This includes routes, detailed accessibility information, and advocacy for better mobility standards.
dataPrivacy.rightsAndAccess: Your Rights and Access to Your Data
dataPrivacy.rightsAndAccessDetails: Users have the right to access, update, or delete their data anytime. Consent can be withdrawn at any moment. We respect your rights and provide tools for managing your data securely.
dataPrivacy.consentDetails: By using Ramp IT Up, you consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal data. Consent can be withdrawn at any time without affecting prior lawful processing. Contact us for any privacy concerns.

termsConditions.title: Terms and Conditions
termsConditions.introductionDetails: These terms govern the use of Ramp IT Up. By accessing our platform, you agree to these terms, which comply with the Philippine Electronic Commerce Act (RA 8792) and Batas Pambansa Bilang 344 for accessibility.
termsConditions.userAgreementDetails: By using Ramp IT Up, you agree to adhere to community guidelines and use the platform in good faith.
termsConditions.prohibitedActionsDetails: Users must avoid illegal or disruptive behavior such as submitting false feedback, engaging in fraud, or compromising security.
termsConditions.intellectualPropertyDetails: All content on Ramp IT Up is protected by intellectual property laws. Unauthorized use or distribution is prohibited.
termsConditions.liabilityLimitationsDetails: Ramp IT Up is not liable for third-party errors or indirect damages. Users must verify safety and suitability of routes or establishments themselves.
termsConditions.governingLawDetails: These terms are governed by Philippine law. Any disputes will be resolved under relevant local legislation.
termsConditions.privacyAndDataProtectionDetails: Ramp IT Up follows data privacy laws like the Philippine Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) to ensure the safety of user information.
termsConditions.modificationsDetails: Updates to these terms will be reflected on this page. Users are encouraged to review the terms periodically.
